recentDiary.text: Went to sleep. Not tired, really. Don't know why. Will wake up on my own.
Explored the same places. Saw nothing I had not seen before. Crickets outside. A bit more bored now.
Sat in the chair at the desk. Used the computer and looked something up. Honey does not spoil. I did not know that. Feel fine.
Rested. Not tired. Feel fine. A bit bored, maybe. Don't know what to do next.
